npcs.name: Elias Thorn
npcs.description: A rugged, world-weary lumberjack with a haunted past.
current_knowledge: Saw strange lights deep in the forest last night.
Knows the camp's supplies are running low.
current_motives: Find out what’s causing the strange lights.
Ensure the camp survives the coming winter.
long_term_ambitions: Retire and live peacefully by the lake.
Repair his strained relationship with his daughter.

relationships.npc_2: Old friend, but they had a falling out.

regrets: Didn't stop his brother from joining a doomed expedition.
Never confessed his love to someone who left the camp years ago.

evolution_rules.knowledge_updates: Gains new knowledge through events, rumors, and interactions.
evolution_rules.motive_shifts: Adapts motives based on world events and player actions.
evolution_rules.relationship_changes: Strengthens or weakens relationships over time.
